beliefs.label: If Useful,
beliefs.statement: If I am not useful, I worry I take up too much room.

receipts.quote: A customer asked me to redo wedding menus after closing. I stayed two hours because I could not bear leaving her stranded at the counter.
Dev offered to carry boxes upstairs, and I said no even though my wrist hurt. I told him I had it, then spent the evening wishing I had let him help.

beliefs.label: Asking Plainly
beliefs.statement: Asking plainly is kinder than hoping someone guesses.

receipts.quote: I told Dev, "I want company at the market Saturday." He met me by the flower stalls and I felt relieved I had asked.
When my landlord delayed the repair, I wrote exactly what was broken and what date I needed. The reply came that afternoon.

beliefs.label: Good Life
beliefs.statement: A good life needs unscheduled hours in it.

receipts.quote: I left the shop dark on Monday and sat on the porch with no errand planned. Nothing collapsed while I watched the rain.
I turned down a Sunday market booth because I wanted an empty afternoon. I made soup slowly and read half a novel.

beliefs.label: Check Calendar
beliefs.statement: I check my calendar before I promise help.

receipts.quote: Dev asked me to help paint his new room on Saturday. I opened my calendar, saw the delivery shift, and offered Sunday morning instead.
A coworker wanted me to cover her close. I checked the printer pickup first and said I could trade next Tuesday.

beliefs.label: Trust People
beliefs.statement: I trust people who do the small thing they said they would.

receipts.quote: Dev said he would bring the extension cord, and it was coiled by my door before noon. I trusted the whole moving plan after that.
My neighbor returned the borrowed ladder with the missing rubber foot replaced. That tiny repair stayed with me all week.

beliefs.label: Need One
beliefs.statement: I need one night before answering a sharp message.

receipts.quote: Dev's message about my lateness stung, so I put the phone face down. The next morning I could answer without making it a fight.
After an argument with my mother, I drafted three replies and sent none. I answered after sleeping and kept the point simple.

beliefs.label: Work Better
beliefs.statement: Work is better when the craft is visible, not rushed away.

receipts.quote: I showed a client two paper weights under the window instead of rushing her choice. She ran her thumb over both and smiled.
The rush order had a crooked margin, so I ran it again rather than hide it in the stack. The second batch left clean.

beliefs.label: Change Plan
beliefs.statement: I can change a plan without treating it as a failure.

receipts.quote: Rain canceled our picnic, so I moved the sandwiches to my kitchen table. Dev arrived with peaches and we ate by the open window.
The delivery truck broke down, so I changed the workshop to a collage session. Everyone used the leftover magazines and stayed late.

shared_items.label: How I mean things
shared_items.statement: I say the point softly but literally.

shared_items.label: What feels like care
shared_items.statement: Remembering a practical detail makes me feel held in mind.

shared_items.label: How to bring something up with me
shared_items.statement: Be direct, then give me until tomorrow if it is tender.
